events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King, Elvis Presley's music still defines generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the shooting incident involving legendary rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today. His influence on music and culture remains undeniable. What's the one Tupac song that always hits different for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi's Genius
angles.copy: On this day, we remember Jimi Hendrix, a true pioneer who redefined the electric guitar. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Forty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable images in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders have always been pure rock and roll.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman and solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Oasis Legend
angles.copy: Big happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite tune from the Oasis legend?

events.title: 'Imagine' Release Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' in 1975.

angles.name: Power of Imagine
angles.copy: The message of John Lennon's 'Imagine' still resonates today, decades after its 1975 release. A powerful song for a powerful vision.

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed everything. Remember life before streaming? What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your favourite 007 and which film is your top pick?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us the sprawling 'White Album'. So much incredible music packed into one release. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly pushed boundaries and influenced so many artists. Which track stands out for you?
